values.name: Market
values.description: Execute immediately at the best available price.

values.name: Limit
values.description: Execute only at `price` or better. Requires `price`.

values.name: Stop
values.description: Triggers a Market order when last trade reaches `stopPrice`.

values.name: StopLimit
values.description: Triggers a Limit at `price` when last trade reaches `stopPrice`.

values.name: TrailingStop
values.description: Stop that trails the market by a fixed distance; triggers a Market.

values.name: TrailingStopLimit
values.description: Stop that trails the market by a fixed distance; triggers a Limit at `price`.

values.name: MIT
values.description: Market-If-Touched. Triggers a Market when last trade reaches a trigger price.

values.name: LimitIfTouched
values.description: Triggers a Limit when last trade reaches a trigger price.

description: Order type. Determines how and when the order executes relative to market price.
